unit_label: Istio Security — workload identity and mTLS
claims_supported: Istio assigns X.509 identities to workloads and rotates certificates through istiod and the agent.
mTLS authenticates service-to-service traffic and secure naming binds identity to service.
AuthorizationPolicy supports ALLOW/DENY/CUSTOM, deny precedence and mTLS-dependent principal rules.
Peer authentication defaults to PERMISSIVE when unset; workloads without authorization policies allow all requests.
